purpose.objective: Evaluate the frozen Phase 05 high-Brent/high-USDRUBF short-USDRUBF candidate schedule using deterministic open-to-close execution and predeclared round-trip cost stress.

inputs.phase6_source_panel: explicit path required; semantic replay must reproduce frozen Phase6 dataset and every consumed entry/exit OHLC row must be non-terminal
inputs.phase05_schedule_binding: recompute deterministically from repository Phase05 logic and pinned upstream inputs, then require exact equality to the frozen schedule below

backtest_definition.cost_grid_interpretation: total round-trip cost stress including fees/slippage allowance; not a claim of exact realized cost

metrics_definition.compounded_net_return_formula: product(1 + net_short_return) - 1 in chronological entry order
metrics_definition.max_drawdown_formula: max(1 - equity / running_peak) on chronological compounded trade equity including initial equity 1.0

sample_policy.interpretation: descriptive/sample-limited only because the frozen Phase05 schedule contains three independent entries

gates.G1_lineage: exact pinned Phase6 and Brent hashes plus Phase6 source-panel semantic replay PASS
gates.G2_frozen_signal_schedule: recomputed Phase05 eligible schedule exactly equals the three frozen entries and all +5/+10/+20 exit dates
gates.G3_price_binding: every consumed entry open and exit close is from a non-terminal source-panel row bound by Phase6 semantic replay
gates.G4_execution_semantics: short USDRUBF; target open entry and fixed future close exits only
gates.G5_return_math: gross short return uses the frozen formula with finite positive prices
gates.G6_cost_math: only 0/5/10/20 bps total round-trip stress is applied once per trade
gates.G7_metrics: declared descriptive metrics only; no horizon ranking, best-variant selection, parameter optimization or statistical inference
gates.G8_research_only: no sizing, model fit, strategy promotion, broker/trading actions, upstream mutation or network
